summary: Sol-Gel Technologies filed a Form 6-K on 2026-09-17, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, disclosing that the last patient completed the last scheduled visit in the pivotal Phase 3 SGT-610-01 trial of patidegib gel 2% in Gorlin syndrome. The randomized, double-blind, vehicle-controlled study enrolled 113 patients, 102 completing 12 months of treatment. Top-line results are expected in late November 2026. This is a routine clinical milestone update, not a special situation, with no transaction terms, securities, or board recommendation involved.
